[!cgo] skip 'cgo is not available'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOEXPERIMENT=nologosfastcgo
cd m
cp main.⚡ $WORK/original.txt
cp overlay/replacement.go $WORK/backing.txt
logos run -trimpath .
stdout '^path: 5$'
stdout 'at main[.]⚡:12$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos build -trimpath --emit-go=$WORK/plain-out
exists $WORK/plain-out/main.go
cd $WORK/plain-out
exec env -u GOROOT GOEXPERIMENT= $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exec env -u GOROOT GOEXPERIMENT= $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt

# The backing file also matches the module-directory trimpath rule.
cd $GOPATH/src/m
logos run -trimpath -overlay=overlay.json .
stdout '^path: 17$'
stdout 'at main[.]⚡:15$'
cp stdout $WORK/overlaid.txt
logos build -trimpath -overlay=overlay.json --emit-go=$WORK/overlay-out
exists $WORK/overlay-out/main.go
! exists $WORK/overlay-out/replacement.go
cmp main.⚡ $WORK/original.txt
cmp overlay/replacement.go $WORK/backing.txt
cd $WORK/overlay-out
exec env -u GOROOT GOEXPERIMENT= $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/overlaid.txt
exec env -u GOROOT GOEXPERIMENT= $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/overlaid.txt

# Source identity is recovered once, before checking. A second rewrite
# would blame twice/wrong.lgo instead of the logical original source.
cd $WORK
! go tool compile -p p -logos.cgoeject -logos.eject=$WORK/bad-out -trimpath=$GOPATH/src/diagnostics/wrong.lgo=>mapped/original.lgo;mapped/original.lgo=>twice/wrong.lgo $GOPATH/src/diagnostics/wrong.lgo $GOPATH/src/diagnostics/_cgo_gotypes.go
stdout '^mapped/original.lgo:4:15: cannot use "bad"'
! exists bad-out

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/cgopaths

go 1.27

-- m/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow"

-- m/main.⚡ --
package main

/*
static int value(void) { return 5; }
static int *missing(void) { return 0; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func checked() *C.int {
	return C.missing()
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("path:", C.value())
	defer func() { fmt.Println("checked:", recover()) }()
	checked()
}

-- m/overlay.json --
{
	"Replace": {
		"main.⚡": "overlay/replacement.go"
	}
}

-- m/overlay/go.mod --
module example.com/cgobacking

go 1.27

-- m/overlay/replacement.go --
package main

/*
static int value(void) { return 17; }
static int *missing(void) { return 0; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

// This source has its own physical name and line layout. The loader
// presents it as the parent module's main source file.

func checked() *C.int {
	return C.missing()
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("path:", C.value())
	defer func() { fmt.Println("checked:", recover()) }()
	checked()
}

-- diagnostics/wrong.lgo --
package p
import "C"

var X C.int = "bad"

-- diagnostics/_cgo_gotypes.go --
package p

type _Ctype_int int32
